config.telephone_agent.help_inbound_rout: What happens on an incoming call: the agent answers, you answer manually, or the call is rejected.
config.telephone_agent.help_auto_answer_: Wait in milliseconds before the agent picks up (0 to 60000, default 1000).
config.telephone_agent.help_backend: Classic uses separate speech recognition and speech output, Gemini Live a single realtime voice model.
config.telephone_agent.help_agent_provid: Language model that runs the conversations and decides on tools. An inherited entry comes from the SIP configuration.
config.telephone_agent.help_asr_provider: Provider that turns the caller's speech into text.
config.telephone_agent.help_asr_mode: Recognition method of the chosen provider, for example Whisper.
config.telephone_agent.help_tts_provider: Provider that speaks the agent's replies.
config.telephone_agent.help_realtime_pro: Profile from Realtime Speech used for the conversation.
config.telephone_agent.help_language: Language of the conversation. Auto detects it during the call.
config.telephone_agent.help_greeting_ena: The agent greets the caller as soon as it has picked up.
config.telephone_agent.help_greeting: Text of the greeting (up to 500 characters). Empty = default greeting.
config.telephone_agent.help_purpose: What the phone line is for and what the agent should handle (up to 8000 characters).
config.telephone_agent.help_style: How the agent should speak, for example short and friendly (up to 8000 characters).
config.telephone_agent.help_prohibitions: Things the agent must never do or say on the phone (up to 8000 characters).
config.telephone_agent.help_unavailable: What happens when the caller asks for something that is not allowed: explain, or explain and hang up.
config.telephone_agent.help_failure_mess: Sentence the agent says on a technical failure (up to 500 characters).
config.telephone_agent.help_goodbye: Sentence used to say goodbye at the end of the call (up to 500 characters).
config.telephone_agent.help_persist_tran: Stores call transcripts permanently. This affects callers' privacy; turn on only where it is permitted.
config.telephone_agent.help_max_duration: Longest call duration in seconds, then the call is ended (30 to 86400, default 3600).
config.telephone_agent.help_idle_timeout: Seconds of silence after which the call is ended (15 to 3600, default 120).
config.telephone_agent.help_turn_timeout: How long the agent may take for one reply before it is aborted (15 to 300 seconds, default 60).
config.telephone_agent.help_max_response: Maximum length of one spoken reply in characters (200 to 5000, default 1200).
config.telephone_agent.help_max_outbound: Daily limit for outgoing calls to cap costs and abuse (1 to 1000, default 10).
config.telephone_agent.help_confirm_live: A live test really places a call and can cost money. Confirm this before you start it.
